content.what_it_is: Defines four tridiagonal solvers. TRIDy_periodic (L59-L326) applies a Sherman-Morrison two-solve construction for a cyclic y-direction system, exchanging periodic corner/end values among processor rows, solving B*y1=d and B*y2=w, computing beta, and returning f=y1+beta*y2. Serial Thomas solvers TRIDy_ser and TRIDx_ser occupy L340-L373 and L387-L399. Parallel pipeline Thomas solvers TRIDx and TRIDy occupy L412-L489 and L503-L578, forwarding reduced coefficients east/north and sending back-substitution values west/south.
entities: TRIDy_ser locals II,JJ and arrays A,C,D,Z @L344-L346
TRIDx_ser locals II,JJ and arrays A,C,D,Z @L391-L393

equations.expr: beta(i) = cyclic correction numerator / cyclic correction denominator

unresolved: Copy/payload mismatch in TRIDx back substitution: only smsg(j,1) is assigned at L481, but MPI_ISEND transmits 2*Nloc elements at L483-L484. Column 2 therefore contains stale/uninitialized values; the matching receive requests 2*Nloc at L461-L462 although only rmsg(j,1) is consumed at L465.

The same back-substitution payload mismatch is copied into TRIDy: only smsg(i,1) is assigned at L571, but 2*Mloc elements are sent at L573-L574; the receiver requests 2*Mloc at L551-L552 and consumes only column 1 at L555.

All Thomas/Sherman-Morrison divisions check only a/A against ZERO (for example L431 and L441), but do not test the effective pivot denominators 1/a-rmsg(:,2), 1/a-c(previous), the cyclic endpoint factors 1+c_end and 1+a_beg (L204/L210), or the Sherman-Morrison beta denominator (L278-L279). A zero effective pivot remains unchecked.

Ordering risk in periodic endpoint exchange: blocking MPI_SEND is issued at L108 before the peer posts MPI_IRECV at L113, and the same send-before-receive pattern recurs for c_end and the y1/y2 endpoint transfers. Completion therefore depends on MPI buffering/eager behavior for message length Mloc rather than a nonblocking send or paired Sendrecv.
Copy-text mismatch: the comment immediately above SUBROUTINE TRIDy calls it TRIDx at L494 even though it implements the y-direction solver at L503.
